draft.content:
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE: NOT FOR SUBMISSION

We request review of this dispute under the merchant-selected challenge-all policy. The following records and limitations are supplied without predicting the outcome.

Case intake identifies order "ATM-1042", disputed amount $92.00, and reason "product_not_received". These are case-intake values, not independently verified findings.

Code supplies factual wording, citations and assessment. The model arranges the inventory only.

BASIS OF THE CHALLENGE
We supply the following selected records of delivery status or acknowledged access, with their transaction context.

PAYMENT AND CASE RECORDS
The payment record reports a captured payment of $92.00. [case_atm_1042:payment]

ORDER RECORDS
The order record lists a quantity of 2. This does not establish ticket issuance or delivery. [case_atm_1042:order]

The order status is recorded as "paid"; this is a source status, not proof of delivery. [case_atm_1042:order]

The recorded event start is November 6, 2026 at 9:00 PM (America/Los_Angeles). [case_atm_1042:order]

TICKET RECORDS
This ticket's status is recorded as "issued". A ticket record does not establish receipt, attendance or cardholder identity. [case_atm_1042:ticket-1]

This ticket's status is recorded as "issued". A ticket record does not establish receipt, attendance or cardholder identity. [case_atm_1042:ticket-2]

DELIVERY RECORDS
The SMS source records status "delivered". Provider-marked delivery does not establish reading, attendance or cardholder identity. [case_atm_1042:sms]

ORDER HISTORY
The history record reports a completed recovery flow for 2 tickets. This is recorded account access, not attendance. [case_atm_1042:recovery]

CUSTOMER AND SUPPORT RECORDS
The selected support export marks a matched customer message as acknowledging receipt for this order. This source acknowledgement flag does not independently establish a delivery channel, attendance or cardholder identity. [case_atm_1042:support-3]

Review the original records and the separate internal evidence inventory before approval. Necessary qualifications are retained with each selected statement. Approval and submission remain separate actions.
